title: Latent Preference Modeling for Multi-Session Personalized Tool Calling
abstract: arXiv:2604.17886v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Users often omit essential details in their requests to LLM-based agents, resulting in under-specified inputs for tool use. This poses a fundamental challenge for tool-augmented agents, as API execution typically requires complete arguments, highlighting the need for personalized tool calling. To study this problem in a more realistic setup, we present Multi-Session Personalized Tool Calling (MPT), a benchmark comprising 4,695 instances over 459 multi-session interaction histories that cover three challenges: Preference Recall, Induction, and Transfer. We further propose PRefine, a test-time memory method that maintains the user's latent preference as a textual hypothesis revised through a generate-verify-refine loop. Across five LLMs, existing memory systems underperform full-history prompting; PRefine outperforms all baselines and alone surpasses it on Preference Transfer. translated_title: 面向多会话个性化工具调用的潜在偏好建模
translated_abstract: 用户在与基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体交互时，常常会在请求中省略关键细节，导致工具调用时的输入信息不完整。这对工具增强型智能体构成了根本性挑战，因为 API 执行通常需要完整的参数，这凸显了个性化工具调用的必要性。为了在更贴近实际的场景中研究这一问题，我们提出了多会话个性化工具调用，这是一个包含 4,695 个实例、覆盖 459 个多会话交互历史的基准数据集，涵盖三项挑战：偏好召回、偏好归纳和偏好迁移。我们进一步提出了 PRefine，一种测试时记忆方法，它将用户的潜在偏好维护为一个文本假设，并通过“生成-验证-精炼”循环不断修正。在五个大语言模型上的实验表明，现有记忆系统的表现不及完整历史提示；而 PRefine 的表现优于所有基线方法，并且是唯一在偏好迁移任务上超越完整历史提示的方法。这些结果表明，用于个性化的记忆……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了多会话个性化工具调用基准 MPT 以及测试时记忆方法 PRefine，通过“生成-验证-精炼”循环将用户潜在偏好维护为文本假设，在五个大语言模型上的表现超越所有基线，并在偏好迁移任务上成为唯一超越完整历史提示的方法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MPT, a benchmark for multi-session personalized tool calling, and proposes PRefine, a test-time memory method that maintains users' latent preferences as textual hypotheses refined through a generate-verify-refine loop, outperforming all baselines across five LLMs and uniquely surpassing full-history prompting on preference transfer.
